summary.text: Amelia Gallitano is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Shawnna Bolick.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a board-certified psychiatrist, neuroscientist and professor.

paragraphs.text: Amelia Gallitano earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago and an M.D. and a Ph.D. from the University of Pennsylvania School of Medicine.

In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign biography said she is a founding faculty member of the University of Arizona College of Medicine-Phoenix and Director of its MD/PhD Program, and that she spent nine years caring for veterans with PTSD at the Phoenix VA.
The biography said she has lived in Legislative District 2 for nearly twenty years and is running to apply policy that follows the evidence on affordability, public education, healthcare, water.
